## Release checklist

- [ ] Architecture boundary reviewed
- [ ] Security / authorization reviewed
- [ ] Database migration added when schema changes
- [ ] Tests or an explicit test contract added
- [ ] i18n updated for EN/HE/AR/RU when user-facing text changes
- [ ] Mobile and desktop states reviewed
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes in CI
- [ ] No secrets, debug output, or generated/watermark markers added

## Risk / rollback

Describe the user impact, migration safety, feature flag, and rollback path.
